Production audio service binding

History opens the saved local source

Seek fixture before active source replacement

Active source replacement retains queue identity and index
A stale second download cannot overwrite an already changed source
Native social entry opens the real OnlineActivity
Opening the shared social/profile page does not pause native music
The isolated own-origin view is ready before room handoff
Browsing the isolated same-origin /rooms view keeps native music playing
Actual same-origin room entry pauses the native player before room audio
Room handoff retains local queue and resume position
Return to the real native activity before notification UI assertions
Finish any genuine API check before native fixture delivery
System notification permission/channel is genuinely enabled
First real Android snapshot establishes baseline without an old notification
A new unread friend request reaches Android's real NotificationManager
System notification contains the genuine event type and actor
Social notification protects lock-screen content
Notification PendingIntent is immutable
Repeated snapshot does not duplicate a native notification
Dedup ids persist outside the page process

First hardware Back is processed

Return to native activity after leaving the room
Open native social Activity for hardware Back test
Own-origin social fixture loaded without an account

Standalone social page exits normally without a close()/Back loop
